verses.original: שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה בִּשְׁנַת֙ לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וִיהוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן־ אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּמְלֹ֖ךְ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh biš·naṯ lî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh wî·hō·w·rām ben- ’aḥ·’āḇ mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·yim·lōḵ bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the eighteenth . . . year of Jehoshaphat’s reign over Judah Jehoram son of Ahab became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria twelve . . . years

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֥א כְאָבִ֖יו וּכְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־ מַצְּבַ֣ת הַבַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָבִֽיו׃ עָשָׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śeh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh raq lō ḵə·’ā·ḇîw ū·ḵə·’im·mōw way·yā·sar ’eṯ- maṣ·ṣə·ḇaṯ hab·ba·‘al ’ă·šer ’ā·ḇîw ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD but not as his father and mother [had done] He removed - the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made

verses.original: רַ֠ק דָּבֵ֑ק בְּחַטֹּ֞אות אֲשֶׁר־ יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּֽן־ נְבָ֛ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ לֹא־ סָ֖ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: raq dā·ḇêq bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ă·šer- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ yiś·rā·’êl he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- lō- sār mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Nevertheless he clung to the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit - he did not turn away from them

verses.original: וּמֵישַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָ֖ב הָיָ֣ה נֹקֵ֑ד וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאָה־ אֶ֣לֶף כָּרִ֔ים צָֽמֶר׃ וּמֵ֥אָה אֶ֖לֶף אֵילִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ša‘ me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ hā·yāh nō·qêḏ wə·hê·šîḇ lə·me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ kā·rîm ṣā·mer ū·mê·’āh ’e·lep̄ ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder and he would render to the king of Israel a hundred thousand lambs and the wool of a hundred thousand rams

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כְּמ֣וֹת אַחְאָ֑ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ מוֹאָ֖ב וַיִּפְשַׁ֥ע בְּמֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·mō·wṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- mō·w·’āḇ way·yip̄·ša‘ bə·me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But after the death of Ahab the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel

verses.original: הַה֖וּא בַּיּ֥וֹם הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם וַיֵּצֵ֞א מִשֹּׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm ham·me·leḵ yə·hō·w·rām way·yê·ṣê miš·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So at that time King Jehoram set out from Samaria and mobilized - all Israel

verses.original: וַיֵּ֡לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל־ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע בִּ֔י הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה אֶל־ מוֹאָ֖ב אֶעֱלֶ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּמ֧וֹנִי כָמ֛וֹךָ כְּעַמִּ֥י כְעַמֶּ֖ךָ כְּסוּסַ֥י כְּסוּסֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ pā·ša‘ bî hă·ṯê·lêḵ ’it·tî lam·mil·ḥā·māh ’el- mō·w·’āḇ ’e·‘ĕ·leh way·yō·mer kā·mō·w·nî ḵā·mō·w·ḵā kə·‘am·mî ḵə·‘am·me·ḵā kə·sū·say kə·sū·se·ḵā
verses.literal: vvv And he sent a message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah The king of Moab has rebelled against me Will you go with me to fight against Moab I will go replied Jehoshaphat I [am] as you [are] my people [are] your people and my horses [are] your horses

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי־ זֶ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ נַעֲלֶ֑ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר אֱדֽוֹם׃ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê- zeh had·de·reḵ na·‘ă·leh de·reḵ miḏ·bar ’ĕ·ḏō·wm way·yō·mer
verses.literal: Then he asked Which way shall we go up By way of the Desert of Edom replied Joram

verses.original: מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּמֶֽלֶך־ יְהוּדָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וַיֵּלֶךְ֩ וַיָּסֹ֕בּוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְלֹא־ הָיָ֨ה מַ֧יִם לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ וְלַבְּהֵמָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl ū·me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏå̄h ū·me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm way·yê·leḵ way·yā·sōb·bū de·reḵ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·lō- hā·yāh ma·yim lam·ma·ḥă·neh ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lê·hem wə·lab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: So the king of Israel the king of Judah and the king of Edom set out and after they had traveled a roundabout route for seven days they had no . . . water for their army or for their . . . animals

verses.original: אֲהָ֕הּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֗ה קָרָ֣א הָאֵ֔לֶּה לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·hāh way·yō·mer me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl kî- Yah·weh qā·rā hā·’êl·leh liš·lō·šeṯ ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Alas said the king of Israel for the LORD has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַאֵ֨ין נָבִיא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פֹּ֤ה וְנִדְרְשָׁ֥ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה מֵאוֹת֑וֹ אֶחָ֞ד מֵעַבְדֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר וַ֠יַּעַן אֱלִישָׁ֣ע בֶּן־ שָׁפָ֔ט פֹּ֚ה אֲשֶׁר־ יָ֥צַק מַ֖יִם עַל־ יְדֵ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yō·mer ha·’ên nā·ḇî Yah·weh pōh wə·niḏ·rə·šāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh mê·’ō·w·ṯōw ’e·ḥāḏ mê·‘aḇ·ḏê me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ben- šā·p̄āṭ pōh ’ă·šer- yā·ṣaq ma·yim ‘al- yə·ḏê ’ê·lî·yā·hū
verses.literal: But Jehoshaphat asked Is there no prophet of the LORD here Let us inquire - of the LORD through him And one of the servants of the king of Israel . . . answered Elisha son of Shaphat is here [He] used to pour water on the hands of Elijah

verses.original: יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֑ה יֵ֥שׁ אוֹת֖וֹ מֶ֧לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וּמֶ֥לֶךְ אֱדֽוֹם׃ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ way·yō·mer də·ḇar- Yah·weh yêš ’ō·w·ṯōw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ū·me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm way·yê·rə·ḏū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Jehoshaphat affirmed The word of the LORD is with him So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him

verses.original: אֱלִישָׁ֜ע וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַה־ לִּ֣י וָלָ֔ךְ לֵ֚ךְ אֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ וְאֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֖י אִמֶּ֑ךָ אַ֗ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ קָרָ֤א הָאֵ֔לֶּה לִשְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים לָתֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yō·mer ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl mah- lî wā·lāḵ lêḵ ’el- nə·ḇî·’ê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·’el- nə·ḇî·’ê ’im·me·ḵā ’al way·yō·mer lōw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl kî- Yah·weh qā·rā hā·’êl·leh liš·lō·šeṯ ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: Elisha, however said to the king of Israel What have we to do . . . with [each other] Go to the prophets of your father and . . . of your mother No replied the king of Israel for it is the LORD who has summoned these three kings to deliver them into the hand of Moab

verses.original: אֱלִישָׁ֗ע וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ חַי־ לְפָנָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי כִּ֗י לוּלֵ֛י אֲנִ֣י נֹשֵׂ֑א פְּנֵ֛י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה אִם־ אַבִּ֥יט אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְאִם־ אֶרְאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ḥay- lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ă·šer ‘ā·maḏ·tî kî lū·lê ’ă·nî nō·śê pə·nê yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’im- ’ab·bîṭ ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’im- ’er·’e·kā
verses.literal: Then Elisha said As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives before whom I stand - were it not vvv for my regard for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah I would not look at you or acknowledge you

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה קְחוּ־ לִ֣י מְנַגֵּ֑ן וְהָיָה֙ הַֽמְנַגֵּ֔ן כְּנַגֵּ֣ן יַד־ יְהוָֽה׃ וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh qə·ḥū- lî mə·nag·gên wə·hā·yāh ham·nag·gên kə·nag·gên yaḏ- Yah·weh wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: But now bring me a harpist And while the harpist played the hand of the LORD came upon Elisha

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּ֖ה יְהוָ֑ה אָמַ֣ר עָשֹׂ֛ה הַזֶּ֖ה הַנַּ֥חַל גֵּבִ֥ים׀ גֵּבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘ā·śōh haz·zeh han·na·ḥal gê·ḇîm gê·ḇîm
verses.literal: and he said This is what the LORD says Dig this valley vvv full of ditches

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר לֹֽא־ תִרְא֥וּ ר֙וּחַ֙ וְלֹֽא־ תִרְא֣וּ גֶ֔שֶׁם הַה֖וּא וְהַנַּ֥חַל יִמָּ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם וּשְׁתִיתֶ֛ם אַתֶּ֥ם וּמִקְנֵיכֶ֖ם וּֽבְהֶמְתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar lō- ṯir·’ū rū·aḥ wə·lō- ṯir·’ū ḡe·šem ha·hū wə·han·na·ḥal yim·mā·lê mā·yim ū·šə·ṯî·ṯem ’at·tem ū·miq·nê·ḵem ū·ḇə·hem·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: For . . . the LORD says You will not see wind . . . . . . or rain but the valley will be filled with water and you will drink you and your cattle and your animals

verses.original: זֹ֖את וְנָקַ֥ל בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְנָתַ֥ן מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת־ בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ wə·nā·qal bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wə·nā·ṯan mō·w·’āḇ ’eṯ- bə·yeḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: This is a simple matter in the sight of the LORD and He will also deliver the Moabites - into your hand

verses.original: וְהִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל־ מִבְצָר֙ עִ֤יר וְכָל־ עִ֣יר מִבְח֔וֹר תַּפִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ טוֹב֙ עֵ֥ץ תִּסְתֹּ֑מוּ וְכָל־ מַעְיְנֵי־ מַ֖יִם תַּכְאִ֖בוּ וְכֹל֙ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה הַחֶלְקָ֣ה בָּאֲבָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hik·kî·ṯem kāl- miḇ·ṣār ‘îr wə·ḵāl ‘îr miḇ·ḥō·wr tap·pî·lū wə·ḵāl ṭō·wḇ ‘êṣ tis·tō·mū wə·ḵāl ma‘·yə·nê- ma·yim taḵ·’i·ḇū wə·ḵōl haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ha·ḥel·qāh bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: And you shall attack every fortified city and every city of importance You shall cut down every good tree stop up every spring . . . and ruin every good field with stones

verses.original: בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיְהִ֤י כַּעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֔ה מַ֥יִם וְהִנֵּה־ בָּאִ֖ים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḇab·bō·qer way·hî ka·‘ă·lō·wṯ ham·min·ḥāh ma·yim wə·hin·nêh- bā·’îm mid·de·reḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wat·tim·mā·lê hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: The next morning . . . at the time of the morning sacrifice . . . water suddenly flowed from the direction of Edom and filled the land - -

verses.original: וְכָל־ מוֹאָב֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי־ הַמְּלָכִ֖ים עָל֥וּ לְהִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑ם מִכֹּ֨ל חֹגֵ֤ר חֲגֹרָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיִּצָּעֲק֗וּ וַיַּעַמְד֖וּ עַֽל־ הַגְּבֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl mō·w·’āḇ šā·mə·‘ū kî- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ā·lū lə·hil·lā·ḥem bām mik·kōl ḥō·ḡêr ḥă·ḡō·rāh wā·ma‘·lāh way·yiṣ·ṣā·‘ă·qū way·ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- hag·gə·ḇūl
verses.literal: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come up to fight against them So all who could bear arms . . . [young] and old were summoned and stationed at the border

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ זָרְחָ֣ה עַל־ הַמָּ֑יִם הַמַּ֖יִם וַיִּרְא֨וּ אֲדֻמִּ֥ים כַּדָּֽם׃ מוֹאָ֥ב מִנֶּ֛גֶד אֶת־
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer wə·haš·še·meš zā·rə·ḥāh ‘al- ham·mā·yim ham·ma·yim way·yir·’ū ’ă·ḏum·mîm kad·dām mō·w·’āḇ min·ne·ḡeḏ ’eṯ-
verses.literal: When they got up early in the morning the sun was shining on the water and [it] looked [as] red as blood to the Moabites across the way -

verses.original: זֶ֔ה הָחֳרֵ֤ב דָּ֣ם וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים נֶֽחֶרְבוּ֙ וַיַּכּ֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְעַתָּ֥ה לַשָּׁלָ֖ל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: zeh hā·ḥo·rêḇ dām way·yō·mə·rū ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ne·ḥer·ḇū way·yak·kū ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wə·‘at·tāh laš·šā·lāl mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: This . . . is blood they exclaimed The kings have clashed swords and slaughtered one - another Now to the plunder Moab

verses.original: וַיָּבֹאוּ֮ אֶל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ וַיַּכּ֣וּ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבוֹ בָ֔הּ וְהַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־ מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ma·ḥă·nêh yiś·rā·’êl yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·qu·mū way·yak·kū ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ way·yā·nu·sū mip·pə·nê·hem way·yå̄·ḇō ḇāh wə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel the Israelites rose up and attacked - them and they fled before them So [the Israelites] invaded [their land] and struck down - the Moabites

verses.original: יַהֲרֹ֡סוּ וְהֶעָרִ֣ים אִישׁ־ יַשְׁלִ֨יכוּ אַבְנ֜וֹ וְכָל־ ט֠וֹבָה חֶלְקָ֣ה וּמִלְא֗וּהָ יִסְתֹּ֙מוּ֙ וְכָל־ מַעְיַן־ מַ֤יִם יַפִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ ט֣וֹב עֵֽץ־ עַד־ בַּקִּ֖יר חֲרָ֑שֶׂת הִשְׁאִ֧יר אֲבָנֶ֛יהָ הַקַּלָּעִ֖ים וַיָּסֹ֥בּוּ וַיַּכּֽוּהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·hă·rō·sū wə·he·‘ā·rîm ’îš- yaš·lî·ḵū ’aḇ·nōw wə·ḵāl ṭō·w·ḇāh ḥel·qāh ū·mil·’ū·hā yis·tō·mū wə·ḵāl ma‘·yan- ma·yim yap·pî·lū wə·ḵāl ṭō·wḇ ‘êṣ- ‘aḏ- baq·qîr ḥă·rā·śeṯ hiš·’îr ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā haq·qal·lā·‘îm way·yā·sōb·bū way·yak·kū·hā
verses.literal: They destroyed the cities and each man threw stones on every good field until it was covered They stopped up every spring . . . and cut down every good tree Only vvv Kir-haraseth was left with stones in place but men with slings surrounded it and attacked it [as well]

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיַּרְא֙ כִּֽי־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה חָזַ֥ק מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וַיִּקַּ֣ח א֠וֹתוֹ שְׁבַע־ מֵא֨וֹת אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֗רֶב לְהַבְקִ֛יעַ אֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱד֖וֹם יָכֹֽלוּ׃ וְלֹ֥א
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ way·yar kî- ham·mil·ḥā·māh ḥā·zaq mim·men·nū way·yiq·qaḥ ’ō·w·ṯōw šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ ’îš šō·lêp̄ ḥe·reḇ lə·haḇ·qî·a‘ ’el- me·leḵ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm yā·ḵō·lū wə·lō
verses.literal: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too fierce for him he took with him seven hundred swordsmen . . . . . . to break through to the king of Edom but they could not prevail . . .

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־ הַבְּכ֜וֹר בְּנ֨וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֗יו וַיַּעֲלֵ֤הוּ עֹלָה֙ עַל־ הַ֣חֹמָ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י גָּד֖וֹל קֶצֶף־ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽעָלָ֔יו וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḵō·wr bə·nōw ’ă·šer- yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ‘ō·lāh ‘al- ha·ḥō·māh way·hî gā·ḏō·wl qe·ṣep̄- ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl way·yis·‘ū mê·‘ā·lāw way·yā·šu·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So he took - his firstborn son who was to succeed him . . . and offered him as a burnt offering on the city wall And there was great fury against the Israelites so they withdrew . . . and returned to [their own] land
